skill_name: Describe the process of decision tree learning.
workflow: Decision tree learning is a supervised machine learning technique used to create a predictive model. It is used to map observations about an item onto a predefined set of classes. The decision tree is generated by splitting a dataset into subsets based on the outcome of previous tests. Each subsequent split is based on whether a condition is true or false and each of these sub-splitting will produce a branch in the decision tree.
